newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yukos to opt for debt rescheduling.
newsitem.headline: Yukos to opt for debt rescheduling.

text.p: Russian industrial holding company Rosprom has proposed that Yukos oil company issue debt to be held by the government as part of a scheme for companies to pay tax arrears, a Rosprom press secretary said on Friday.

The government put together a plan last month which allows major tax debtors to restructure their arrears and fines on condition that they issue debt or shares to be held by the government, and which it could sell if the companies lagged repayment schedules.
The Federal Bankruptcy Commission has been charged with suing debtors which do not opt for debt rescheduling.
Yukos shareholders voted in February to institute external management by Rosprom as part of the process of integration of the two companies. Rosprom is Bank Menatep's industrial holding company.
